description: Returns server-verified Premium status, diary tool usage, remaining Free allowance, UTC reset time and request caps for the connected account. An unavailable entitlement check reports unknown, never Premium. This lookup does not consume the diary allowance and remains subject to request rate limits. Does not sell or upgrade subscriptions.
name: get_account_status

protocolRequestLimit.description: All MCP protocol requests per account per UTC day, including status and discovery.

remainingFreeCalls.description: Remaining Free diary allowance; Premium may continue above it within request caps.

serviceProtocolRequestLimit.description: All MCP protocol requests per UTC day across the service.

used.description: Diary tool attempts used today; blocked Free attempts are capped at the Free allowance.
